summary: Player-3 won after 42 turns in a hard-fought game! The game saw dramatic momentum swings, with Player-3 using a strategic WildDraw4 on turn 16 to devastate Player-2's position. Despite both Player-1 and Player-3 reaching 2-3 cards multiple times, Player-3 ultimately prevailed by playing Red-6 followed by Red-9 and finally Yellow-5 to win.
